guide.title: User Guide
guide.faq1_q: The pipeline is taking too long, what should I do?
guide.faq1_a: Decrease the GNN epoch count in Settings (default 100). Disable the Optuna hyperparameter search.
guide.faq2_q: Which files should be in the spatial data folder?
guide.faq2_a: filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5 and spatial/ subfolder (containing tissue_positions.csv, scalefactors_json.json, and at least one image file) must be present.
guide.faq3_q: Which format is supported for scRNA-seq reference?
guide.faq3_a: .h5ad (AnnData), .tsv (TPM matrix, rows=genes, columns=cells) and .h5 formats are supported.
guide.faq4_a: Run a separate analysis for each patient (different Patient ID and Output Folder). Then select and compare the two output folders from the Multi-Patient tab.
guide.step1_desc: Select Setup from the left menu. Select your spatial data folder (must contain 10x Visium output — filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5 + spatial/ subfolder) and scRNA-seq reference file (.h5ad or .tsv).
guide.step2_desc: Fill in the Patient ID (used in the report file name). Select an output folder — analysis results will be saved here.
guide.step3_desc: Click the "Start Analysis" button. The pipeline can be tracked from the Pipeline tab. 5 stages run automatically: Preprocessing → Deconvolution → GNN → Visualization → Clinical Report.
guide.step4_desc: When analysis completes, the Results, Figures, Quality, and Model tabs will load automatically. You can zoom/pan on the spatial map.
guide.step5_desc: View the clinical report from the Report tab. Includes WHO grade, IDH/MGMT status, and treatment recommendations. Use the "Open PDF" button to open it as a PDF.
guide.zone_desc: IVY GAP tumor zone classification (Pseudopalisading, Leading Edge, etc.)
guide.drug_desc: Therapeutic response score computed by GNN at each spot
guide.risk_desc: Relative risk score calculated using TCGA survival data
guide.celltype_desc: Dominant cell type at each spot (Tangram deconvolution)
guide.celltype_color: Unique HSL color for each cell type
guide.lr_desc: Most active LR interaction score at each spot (GNN attention weighted)

about.title: About
about.subtitle: Spatial Tumor Microenvironment Atlas
about.project_p1: Glio-Cartography is a clinical decision support system that automatically analyzes spatial transcriptomic data of glioblastoma (GBM) patients, performing cell-type deconvolution and GNN-based tumor zone mapping.
about.project_p2: Operating on 10x Visium Spatial Transcriptomics data, it characterizes the tumor microenvironment (TME) at a regional level, applying IVY GAP zone classifications such as Pseudopalisading Necrosis, Microvascular Proliferation, and Leading Edge.
about.disclaimer: ⚕️ Clinical Disclaimer: This software is for research purposes only. The clinical predictions it generates (WHO grade, IDH/MGMT status, treatment recommendations) are based on computational proxy metrics and do not replace certified pathological evaluation. It must not be used in clinical decision-making.
